projects.title: blend:it — Distributed Blender Rendering Platform
projects.description: A distributed render farm that splits .blend files into per-frame jobs, farms them to volunteer worker nodes, and tracks progress in real time.
projects.longDescription: Team-of-two project. I built the full React 19 / TypeScript single-page frontend (40+ views) — auth with email verification, .blend upload with frame-range control, a live rendering-progress dashboard, an AI image/3D studio, and a real-time community hub — plus two FastAPI microservices: a Q&A + WebSocket chat service (SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL) and a Stability AI text-to-image / image-to-3D service that streams multi-MB assets. These integrate with a 9-service Spring Boot render pipeline over RabbitMQ with Google Cloud Storage hand-off.

projects.title: SUST CSE Carnival 2026 — Event Registration & Operations Platform
projects.description: The full-stack platform that ran SUST’s flagship CS festival: public site, paid team registration, and an admin operations panel used on-site across multiple universities.
projects.longDescription: Team of two, ~140 of 568 commits over five months. Next.js 16 / React 19 frontend and an Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL modular API. I shipped features end to end (UI + API + schema): a support-ticket chat system, a per-segment FAQ module, a food-token pipeline generating printable PDFs, and a voucher system. Also migrated transactional email from SMTP to the Gmail REST API (OAuth2) to eliminate host timeouts, and built the admin panel’s Redux Toolkit / RTK Query foundation. Payments via SSLCommerz / bKash.

projects.title: Client Onboarding OS — Closed-Won to Kickoff Automation
projects.description: An automation platform that turns a closed-won HubSpot deal into a fully provisioned client delivery handoff, with SLA visibility, across 8 integrations.
projects.longDescription: Solo. Contract/deposit gating (DocuSign + Stripe), ClickUp/Drive/Slack provisioning, tokenized client intake with reminders, and Calendly kickoff reconciliation. Built as 28 n8n workflows plus a 13-migration PostgreSQL system of record with an enum-driven 13-state lifecycle, idempotent deal ingestion, persisted provider resource IDs, and per-provider retryable provisioning. Manager dashboard and client intake portal in Next.js 16; local infra as Docker Compose.

projects.title: Cleanroom — Local Metadata Remover & AI-Text Detector
projects.description: A local-only web app that strips metadata from images, video, text, and Office/PDF files by rebuilding each format and verifying nothing residual survived.
projects.longDescription: Solo. The HTTP server is written on the Python standard library only, orchestrating ExifTool, FFmpeg, and mat2 via subprocess. Verification-first: decoded-pixel SHA-256 comparison for images, per-stream property checks for video, tool re-probe for documents — it refuses to return an unverified file. Also integrates a RADAR-Vicuna-7B AI-text detector with sliding-window CPU inference, thread-safe lazy model loading, and language-aware abstention, plus a fact-preserving OpenAI revision pass with an automatic no-op rejection check.

projects.title: MoodMap — Real-Time Crowd Mood Map
projects.description: A real-time web app where users anonymously drop colour-coded "mood pins" on a live city map; pins are crowd-verified and auto-expire.
projects.longDescription: Solo. React + Leaflet + Socket.io frontend, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL + Redis backend. Live pin fan-out over Socket.io, crowd-verification credibility scoring, 2-hour auto-expiry background jobs, in-app OSRM routing, and anonymous-but-accountable ownership via device-fingerprint session middleware with Redis-backed rate limiting. Vitest + supertest suite for the pin/vote service layer.

projects.title: ZFR — Fashion E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A full fashion storefront plus a broad admin CMS on Next.js 16 and MongoDB — ~17k LOC, ~39 versioned REST endpoints.
projects.longDescription: Solo. Storefront: browse, cart, multi-step and guest checkout, live search, account area, zone-based Bangladesh shipping (64-district selector). Admin CMS: products, categories, hero/nav content, orders, media, users, an audit trail of all admin actions, and an analytics/event-tracking pipeline. NextAuth v5, TanStack Query + Zustand, Cloudinary, and an in-memory MongoDB for a one-command local dev flow.

projects.title: ExpressFlow — Parcel Delivery Management System
projects.description: A role-based logistics platform (Customer / Delivery Crew / Admin) with Stripe checkout and live GPS tracking on a map.
projects.longDescription: Solo. React 19 + RTK Query frontend, Express 5 + Mongoose + TypeScript API structured as self-contained feature modules ({controller, service, route, model, validation}). JWT access/refresh auth, Zod validation middleware, RBAC, and a centralized error handler. Socket.io live location updates, Stripe payment intents, public tracking-ID lookup, and client-side PDF export. Deployed serverless on Vercel.

projects.title: Clinic Appointment Automation
projects.description: A serverless appointment system for a single-doctor clinic: 7 n8n workflows are the entire backend, with a Next.js patient/admin/doctor UI.
projects.longDescription: Solo. Booking, 24h/2h reminders, cancellation, reschedule, an 8 AM daily staff summary, and a panel API — all as n8n workflows integrating Airtable (database), Google Calendar, and Gmail. Every Next.js API route is hardened with a safeJson parser and a dual test/prod webhook fallback so the panels stay up when one n8n environment is down. Idempotent reminders via per-record sent-state flags.

projects.title: RepoInsight AI — Tech-Venture Concept, Prototype & Pitch
projects.description: A full startup-validation package (CSE 350) for an AI + static-analysis code-review SaaS: Lean Canvas, financial model, working prototype, and investor pitch.
projects.longDescription: University group project. Built the cash-flow & breakeven model as a Python (openpyxl) generator that emits a fully formula-driven 3-sheet Excel workbook, and a functional single-page hi-fi prototype in vanilla JS with input validation, a 6-stage animated scan state machine, PRNG-seeded deterministic report generation, and real browser print-to-PDF. Plus a 13-slide self-contained HTML pitch deck and a timed presentation script.

projects.title: Java Socket Chat — Same-Network Multi-Client Messaging
projects.description: A minimal TCP client-server chat in core Java (thread-per-connection) built to learn socket programming and concurrency.
projects.longDescription: Solo learning project. ServerSocket bound to 0.0.0.0, one thread per client, line-oriented protocol over BufferedReader / PrintWriter. No external libraries or build tool.

projects.title: Browser Screen/Audio Recorder
projects.description: A browser recorder that captures screen video plus microphone audio in one stream, previews it, and uploads the .webm to a server gallery.
projects.longDescription: Solo learning project. Vanilla JS with the MediaRecorder / getDisplayMedia / getUserMedia Web APIs — merges video and audio tracks into one MediaStream, buffers ondataavailable chunks into a Blob, and posts it as multipart/form-data. No dependencies.
